verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents an official Cafe CLI (`cafe`). It handles sign-in and Git credential setup, and manages repositories, pull requests, stacks and issues from the terminal. It also has agent-friendly flags: `--json` for structured output, `--no-input` to fail instead of prompting, `--yes` to confirm destructive actions, and `cafe api` for authenticated calls to any REST endpoint. A probe confirmed the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in practice.
